subject: CloudRamp follow-up: model-quality checks & next test plan
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha.park@cloudramp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dirk Mueller <dirk@cloudramp.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick follow-up and requests

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo today — Dirk and I appreciated the clear latency breakdown and the live compare vs the hyperscaler endpoint. A couple quick items we want to capture from our side so we can move to a short evaluation: 

- Primary ask: can Redwood run the model-quality probes we shared and return hallucination-rate and factuality diffs vs our current hyperscaler baseline (CloudRamp Endpoint v3)?
- Secondary: we need guidance on prompt-handling differences (stop tokens, role-prefix behavior) that caused the odd truncation we saw on the third example.
- Logistics: we'd like a 72-hour smoke run with your SE to validate regressions on our 1k sample prompts. We'll attach the sample CSV and a comparison matrix.

Attachments: cloudramp_eval_prompts.csv, compare_matrix_cloudramp_vs_hyperscaler.xlsx

Can you confirm a plan and who from Redwood will own the run and analysis?

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Park
Director, AI Platform
CloudRamp

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@cloudramp.com>
Cc: Dirk Mueller <dirk@cloudramp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-14T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick follow-up and requests

Samantha — great meeting, and thanks for the materials. Confirming next steps from Redwood's side: 

1) Ownership: Marissa (SE) will run the smoke evaluation and own the results; I'll coordinate and be the deal contact.
2) Scope: 72-hour run, using the 1k sample CSV you attached. We'll run three experimental arms: Redwood default quantized runtime, Redwood with prefix-KV caching enabled, and the CloudRamp baseline you shared (for side-by-side diffs).
3) Metrics we'll report: hallucination rate (N-gram fact mismatch), F1 on entity recall where you provided gold labels, average token latency (p50/p95), and cost-per-1k tokens for each arm.
4) Prompt-handling: we'll enumerate differences (stop tokens, role prefixes) and provide a short README for adjustments.

Marissa — can you confirm availability for a kickoff call tomorrow (7/15) and that you have access to the Drive link Samantha referenced? Laura — heads-up on the ask for a short commercial note if we see regression risk; we may need a one-off credit to de-risk the PoC.

Aditya
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Park <samantha.park@cloudramp.com>, Dirk Mueller <dirk@cloudramp.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick follow-up and requests

On Thu, Jul 15, 2027 at 12:05 PM PDT, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:

Aditya / Laura — I can run the smoke tests. Proposed checklist for the 72-hour run: 

- Day 0 (prep): ingest CSV, validate formatting, map gold labels where present, sanity-run 50 prompts to confirm prompt-handling parity.
- Days 1–3: run full 1k through three arms; collect per-prompt logs (response text, token count, timing).
- Post-run: generate a diff heatmap for hallucination triggers and a short report (max 2 pages) summarizing F1, hallucination%, latency, and cost.

Technical notes for Samantha/CloudRamp: we noticed a mismatch in role-prefix handling in your examples — Redwood treats a leading system role token differently when client-provided role markers are included. We'll include a minimal example in the README so you can reproduce locally.

I have the Drive link and will upload redwood_probe_config.json and the run logs to that folder; planning kickoff at 9:30am PT 7/15 unless you prefer a different time.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Park <samantha.park@cloudramp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dirk Mueller <dirk@cloudramp.com>, cloudops@cloudramp.com
Date: 2027-07-15T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick follow-up and requests

Thanks Marissa — 9:30am PT tomorrow works. I've uploaded a slightly updated CSV with 1k+20 edge cases (filename: cloudramp_eval_prompts_v2.csv) to the Drive folder and added brief notes in the compare matrix about prompts that surfaced truncation.

Two clarifications before the run: 
- Can the smoke run preserve per-request metadata (request_id, prompt_group) in logs? We need that for cross-checking our offline labeler.
- For the hallucination metric: we compute a token-level factuality mismatch using your output and our golds. Is that compatible with the Redwood metric you described, or should we expect small variances?

Attachments: cloudramp_eval_prompts_v2.csv (uploaded to Drive)

Best,
Samantha

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@cloudramp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-16T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick follow-up and requests

Samantha — high level confirmation and answers: 

- Yes, Marissa will preserve per-request metadata (request_id, prompt_group) in the run logs and will hand over a mapping file for your offline labeler. We'll provide logs as newline-delimited JSON in the Drive folder.
- Hallucination metric: our implementation reports token-level mismatch and a secondary sentence-level sanity check. There can be minor differences vs your tooling (mainly around tokenization boundaries); we'll include both raw outputs and our processed metric so you can compute using your pipeline.
- Deliverables: run logs + diff heatmap + 2-page summary + recommended prompt fixes + short README on role-prefix/stop-token differences. Expected delivery: EOD 7/18 (subject to no major regressions).

Laura — please pencil in a potential $5k onboarding credit should the regression risk exceed our internal threshold; I'll follow up with a short note if that becomes necessary.

Samantha / Dirk — thanks again. We'll see you on the kickoff call 7/15 9:30am PT (calendar invite sent).

Aditya
